description: Tracey Mann is a lifelong Kansan. He grew up in Quinter, attended Quinter High School, and attended Kansas State University. He served as the 50th Lt. Governor of Kansas. Tracey and Audrey live in Salina with their 4 children (Quincy, Austin, Whitney, and Elise).
